units.name: SoundInit
units.summary: Reset the sound driver: no music/effect requests, sweep units off, master level $7F, enable the four tone channels.

units.name: SoundUpdate
units.summary: One frame of the driver. A pending effect request is started at SndStartSfx; otherwise the four music channels are processed in turn (SndChannel 0-3): when a channel's timer expires its stream is read (notes, durations, commands), periods are written for channels not owned by an effect, then envelopes/vibrato are applied (SndApplyEnvelope, SndApplyVolume). The effect sequencer (SndUpdateSfx) runs last.

units.name: SndApplyEnvelope
units.summary: Per-channel note processing after the stream step (channel SndChannel): 1. note cut: $07E7 counts down from $07E4 at the start of each note; at 0 the note becomes a rest. 2. volume envelope restart on a rest/new note ($0441/$0442 -> $041F/$0420 pointer). 3. volume envelope step: entries (volume, frames); a negative volume byte holds ($0428). 4. vibrato: after the delay $EC,X, every $043B frames the period low byte moves by $0438 up/down between the limits set by $0435 ($EF,X counter, $F2,X direction), written to the APU unless a sound effect owns the channel.

units.name: SndApplyVolume
units.summary: Write channel X's duty/volume register (Y = 4*X) from the shadow $07E0. MusicStatus is used as a fade-out level here: the volume is reduced by MusicStatus (minimum 1 or 2), the triangle is muted when the fade passes 5, and every $12-$18 frames (counter $0447, stepped on channel 2) the fade advances; at 10 the music stops (MusicStatus = $FF, SfxRequestFlag = 0). Rests write volume 0 ($30/$80). Skipped for channels owned by a sound effect.

regions.summary: Code (CPU $861C-$86AD, bank 00): SndUpdateSfx (see units). Routines and branch labels reviewed in rounds 1-5.

units.name: SndUpdateSfx
units.summary: Sound-effect sequencer. The five request slots MusicRequest..$07DF are ranked by the priority table SfxPriorityTable ($9D00, lower = more important, $7F = lowest); the best request becomes SndSfxState. It replaces the running effect when its priority is not worse than SfxPriority; it then loads the effect stream (SfxStreamPtrs $9D28) and takes over channels as its commands touch them. Each frame the effect stream is interpreted: byte $FF ends the effect (channels returned to the music, priority reset to $7F); otherwise the high nibble selects channel+1 ($FE) and the low nibble a command from SfxCommandTable: 0 volume, 1 period, 2 volume add, 3/5 period up/down, 4 volume fade, 6 wait n frames, 7 wait add, 8/9 loop.

units.name: FieldMap
units.summary: Stadium field metatile map of pair 2: 75 stored rows of 128 bytes (row r of the 79-row field is at $8000 + (r - r/16)*128; rows with r&15 = 15 are not stored), continuing into the upper bank up to $A57F. Each byte is a metatile id expanded through the field metatile set at $AF80. Only columns 0-110 are scrolled into view (ColRightTable); LookupFieldCell reads its per-metatile cell property bytes from the spare columns $70-$7F of these rows ($8800 + ((id-1)>>5)*256 + $70/$F0 + ((id-1)&15)) and pixel masks from the $9000 page, so those columns hold collision data rather than map cells (LookupFieldCell maps pair 2 only; the copies in the other pairs are presumably equivalent).

Loads the stadium's background palette for the variant (HomeRunBgPalette), draws screen 16 of pair 4 with FarCall entry 4, CHR R0 = $5A, then shows the variant: 0 - HomeRunBannerA: two text blocks revealed row by row; 1 - HomeRunBatterCard: the batter's card (team colours, name, position, statistics); 2 - HomeRunBannerAnim: text plus two animated sprite figures. units.name: TradeChoosePlayer
units.summary: Phase 2 for side SidePad: A stores the cursor place (FreePitcherSlot / FreeBatterSlot for side 0 / 1) and computes the record pointers (TradeRecordPtrsA / TradeRecordPtrsB); side 0 then hands over to side 1 (phase 1 again), side 1 goes to phase 3. B goes back to the team choice (mode 36). The D-pad moves the cursor: side 0 with the roster-grid movers of bank 25, side 1 with TradeCursorRight/Left/Up/Down, which only stop on occupied places of the chosen kind; each move plays $21 and redraws (bank 25 $A6FD).

units.name: TradeCursorRight
units.summary: Side 1: move one column right (pitchers: +3 in a 2x3 grid; fielders: +4 in a 3x4 grid, wrapping) until an occupied place is found.

units.name: TradeCursorLeft
units.summary: Side 1: move one column left (wrapping) until an occupied place is found.

units.name: TradeCursorUp
units.summary: Side 1: move one place up (wrapping) until an occupied place is found.

units.name: TradeCursorDown
units.summary: Side 1: move one place down (wrapping) until an occupied place is found.

units.name: TradeRecordPtrsA
units.summary: Side 0: $058E/F = $6200 + 16*place; $0590/1 = $6320 + 8*place for a pitcher place (< 6), else $FFFF.

units.name: TradeRecordPtrsB
units.summary: Side 1: $0592/3 = $6400 + 16*place; $0594/5 = $6520 + 8*place for a pitcher place, else $FFFF.

units.name: ScaleBySine

units.name: MulSigned16ByFrac
units.summary: Signed fixed-point multiply: Temp04/05 = (Temp04/05 * Temp02) / 256, rounded through IncTemp04Word. The sign is removed first and restored at the end.

units.name: NegateTemp04Word

units.name: IncTemp04Word

units.name: Divide8

units.name: Divide24By16
units.summary: Unsigned divide: dividend Temp00:Temp05:Temp04 (24-bit) by divisor Temp03:Temp02. The quotient replaces Temp04/05 (and Temp00), the remainder is left in Temp06/Temp07.

units.summary: Convert a binary number to four packed decimal digits. Input Temp0C/0D (with Temp0E), pre-scaled by ScaleTemp0CBy... (C593); output Temp0D = thousands/hundreds, Temp0C = tens/ones (packed BCD nibbles). Uses Divide24By16 by 1000 and DivideLoop8/Divide8 by 100 and 10. Exact input scaling is tentative.

units.name: PrepareDecimalDividend

units.name: SubTemp0CFromTemp04

units.name: FarDrawScreenInline
units.summary: FarCall entry 2 (6 inline bytes after the JSR): rendering is turned off and a full nametable is drawn from compressed screen data. Inline: metatile table pointer (-> $37/$38), screen data pointer (-> Temp14/15), sprite CHR set, nametable high byte ($20 or $24). Each screen byte is a 2x2 metatile: two tiles go straight to PPUDATA, the lower two are staged at $6600 and flushed after each row (DrawMetatile); then 64 attribute bytes are copied. Data is read from the FarCall pair.

units.name: FarDrawScreenIndexed
units.summary: FarCall entry 4 (5 inline bytes): like FarDrawScreenInline but the metatile table comes from MetatileSetTable[index] and the screen data from ScreenDataTable[index], read with a given pair; screen data is copied in 128-byte chunks to ColumnBuffer (CopyScreenChunk).

units.name: CopyScreenChunk
units.summary: Map the screen-data pair (Temp16), copy 128 bytes from (Temp14)+Temp01 to ColumnBuffer, restore pair Temp17.

units.name: DrawMetatile
units.summary: Write metatile A: upper two tiles to PPUDATA, lower two to the $6600 row stage. After 16 metatiles (X = $20 or $60) the staged lower row is written out. Increments Temp01 (screen index).

units.name: FarDrawLineupScreen
units.summary: FarCall entry 5. Loads palette 8, clears $0140-$0157, then draws rows of 2x3-tile entries taken from the $8E04 table (6 bytes per entry, indexed by the list at $0716) directly to the PPU, using one of the start addresses in the $CD98 table selected by $04CE. Then sets up VRAM jobs per roster slot. Tentative: team line-up / roster display (name plates).

units.name: DrawFieldObject
units.summary: Emit object X (CurObject) in the fielding view. Meta-sprite index = ObjAnim*8 + $05E2 (facing/frame) looked up through MetaSpritePtrs+2; the record's first byte becomes Temp00 (frame id) and its second byte's bit 6 (horizontal flip) is merged into $0636. $06D0 is a 16-frame hold timer: while it runs a changed frame is replaced by the previous one ($0716/$0732), which slows animation changes. Then the sprite pieces are emitted (EmitMetaSprite) into OAM columns of stride $14 starting at $048A.

units.name: DrawObjectSprite
units.summary: Draw meta-sprite ObjAnim of object CurObject at its position (screen-space version used by the at-bat view); preserves the PRG pair.

units.name: EmitMetaSprite
units.summary: Emit one meta-sprite piece from (Temp12),Y to OamBuffer,X. Piece = attribute (XORed with Temp02), tile, X offset (negated when Temp03 = horizontal flip), Y offset; $FF as attribute ends the list (Temp10 = X). NoSideControl = 2 forces tile bit 7. Pieces whose X or Y leaves the screen (carry into the high byte) are hidden with Y = $F0.

units.name: ObjectScreenPos
units.summary: Temp04/05 = object X/Y low bytes (screen space).

units.name: ObjectWorldToScreen
units.summary: Add the per-object draw offsets $0644 (X) / $0652 (Y) to Temp05/Temp04; Temp02 = attribute byte $0636, Temp03 = its flip bit 6. For flipped sprites X is mirrored (minus 8 and twice the X offset).

units.name: ObjectDepthOrder
units.summary: Advance the per-object animation cel: $060C = cel index into the 3-byte cel list at (Temp0C) (pointer lo, hi, duration), $061A = frames left on the cel. When the timer is 0 the next cel is taken (wrapping at Temp0F cels); otherwise it counts down unless ObjFlagsA bit 7 freezes it. Temp12/13 = the current cel's sprite list. (Name kept from round 1; the routine is an animation stepper, not depth sorting.)

units.name: GetMetaSpritePtr
units.summary: Copy the 4-byte animation header of animation A (MetaSpritePtrs + 4*A) to Temp0C-Temp0F: cel list pointer, ?, cel count; also stores the last byte in $0628,X.

units.name: ScoreRun
units.summary: A runner crossed home. Counts the run in PlayerRunsTally (index = pitcher charged with the runner ($058E,X) * 2 + fielding side), plays sound $30 and, unless ActiveFielderCount is set, credits the batter (CountRbiOrRun). Adds the run to RunsVisitor/RunsHome (indexed by SidePad = batting side), updates the line score (RecordInningRuns) and the 3-digit display digits $04D0/$04D2/$04D4. Game-ending checks: 100 runs, a bottom half from the 9th on (HalfInning >= $11) where the home side leads (walk-off), or a 10-run lead in an earlier bottom half -> HomeRunFlag = 1, PlayFlags bit 7 and PlayOverDelay = $82.

units.name: Reset
units.summary: Power-on/reset entry (vector at $FFFC). Silences DMC, disables APU frame IRQ, turns the PPU off, sets the stack, waits two vblanks, resets the MMC3 (PRG mode 0, vertical mirroring bit 0, PRG RAM enabled), initialises the game (InitGame), enables NMI and falls into MainLoop.

units.name: RunGameModeFrame
units.summary: Run one frame of GameMode. CheckModeButtons handles Start/Select first. If GameModeWaitPpu[GameMode] is nonzero the PpuBuffer must be empty before the handler runs. The PRG pair GameModePrgPair[GameMode / 2] is mapped and GameModeHandlers[GameMode] is entered through JumpTableDispatch (the handler returns straight to MainLoop).

units.name: Nmi
units.summary: NMI handler. Always: CHR/IRQ setup for the layout (SetupLayoutIrq). If NmiLockout is set, only records JoyReadDeferred and runs the sound update. Otherwise: OAM DMA, CHR bank refresh for ScreenLayout, nametable strip streaming, the special mode-5 VRAM check, PpuBuffer flush (unless locked), palette upload, scroll, extra VRAM jobs, sprite-0 split, joypad read (skipped for PpuBufFormat 2), play clock, then re-enables NMI in PPUCTRL; finally the sound update and FrameReady is cleared. The title layout (ScreenLayout 11) takes a short path: palettes and VRAM jobs only.

editorial_audit.notes: Final acceptance review 2026-11-17 (round 5), targeted rather than a whole-source reread; prior review credit reused. Checked: all 4,111 scaffold entries and 3,453 units across banks 0-31, header and CHR (reviewed status, non-empty summaries, every source location in range, every unit name on one of its source lines, entry locations on their region headers); round-5 additions (1,484 fragment and label units, sampled new block comments, the 14 bank-30/31 cross-pair call notes, each target address recomputed from the bank source); the pitcher/batter card label swap (bank 25 DrawPlayerCard tests ObjTask+1, which ReleasePickPlayer/PlayerSelectPickPlayer set to 0 for roster places 0-5, so the swap is supported and applied consistently); stale status wording, placeholders/TODOs, address-only labels and RAM alias naming. Fixed: PendingPitcherChange role contradicted between ram.inc, MenuCancelCheck and Mode14TimeOut/TimeOutChooseSide (value 2 was called 'computer-vs-computer play'; the code sets 1 on a pinch hit/run for the pitcher and Mode9HalfInningEnd advances it to 2, forcing the time-out pitching change; TimeOutChooseSide fakes A for side 1, not side 0); card screen/metatile labels made consistent with the swap (ScreenPlayerCard -> ScreenBatterCard, MetatilesPitcherCard -> MetatilesPlayerCard); about 130 unit summaries cut off mid-word restored from their source comments; 33 hyphenation artifacts; 4,078 boilerplate entry summaries replaced by CPU range, bank and the region's own source note or unit list; 904 long fragment summaries that repeated the whole routine comment (some clipped before its 'Tentative' caveat) now point to the routine comment; one cross-pair call note confirmed as pair 6 and the other narrowed; duplicated 'banks N: bank N:' prefixes in ram.inc; prior-ambiguity wording for two fallback blocks set in the past tense. Residual limitations: many raw RAM operands (e.g. $04FB, $057F, $06A1) and some table operands keep address-based form because their roles are unknown; ScreenRecordNN labels are index names for records reached only through ScreenDataTable; one $8274 call still assumes pair 6 on unchecked home-run paths; 127 uncommented global fall-through labels rely on their routine headers; short data-unit summaries are terse but accurate. The 8 bytes in regions 5155-5158 (bank 2 $80DA-$80DB, $9988-$998B, $9B48; bank 9 $A165) are generic Data of unknown meaning classified only by a user-directed Manual fallback, not by observed or static evidence; no semantics are claimed for them.
